description: This file defines the Java interface 'OptionParser' which specifies a contract for parsing input strings into a list of 'Option' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares a single method 'parse' that takes a string input and returns a list of Option instances.

classes.name: OptionParser
classes.description: A Java interface that specifies the contract for option parsing implementations within the project.

methods.description: Method signature for parsing a string input into a list of Option objects.
